synthetic_offline_trace.evidence_kind: synthetic offline trace using recorded startup and rest answers; no native I/O or inference

root_cause.brain: brain.py:231-238 returns one Rest action without replacing/suspending _script or _plan; react_monster attack replaces script at 216-223. Generic next_action is not executed as an action dispatch.
root_cause.host: agent_runtime.py:559-583 builds one state, delivers events immediately, then timers, then unconditionally steps script in same tick; 636-642 executes reaction immediately. There is no _action_queue or _last_script arbitration in current app source.
root_cause.script: scripts.py:62-73 and 96-112 rest only while received hp_ratio <0.25; no hysteresis/recovery owner. At or above 0.25 attacks resume. BotState.hp_ratio derives hp/max_hp at model.py:80-82.
root_cause.native: playing_runtime.py:226-249 validates received state then sends Attack if alive and eligible, with no pose, recovery or pending-motion interlock. Rest reaches wire.sit, not an enum-only no-op. client.py:613-617 emits action2/3. Movement alone uses _require_standing at playing_runtime.py:274-296,476-490. Pending motion does not hold brain script steps or Attack.
root_cause.keepalive: playing_runtime.py:320-360 pumps keepalive while draining native events before cognition. Recovery must not skip this drain or weaken received-state readiness.
root_cause.evidence_limit: Retained decision summaries have no request snapshots or decision timestamps. Aggregate ACT3 includes damage and pose, not a proved count of SELF sit/stand. Stopmove 0x0088 is not stopattack. Exact live per-rest wire ordering cannot be reconstructed; offline actual-code trace proves the causal seam.

pinned_public_server.action_semantics: rathena/src/map/clif.cpp:11697-11830: normal0 vs repeat7; unit_stop_attack before switch at11711; sit requires NV_BASIC>=3 or SU_BASIC_SKILL>=1 when basic_skill_check; pc_setsit then clif_sitting at11773-11775. No attack-triggered stand call in this handler.
pinned_public_server.sit_stop: rathena/src/map/pc.hpp:1149 pc_setsit stops walking and attack, sets sitting. This does not prevent host sending a fresh attack next.
pinned_public_server.damage_stand: rathena/src/map/pc.cpp:9682-9695 sourced positive HP damage force-stands a sitting character, independent of healthy HP. pc_setstand:13099-13118 publishes standing and resets sitting regen ticks. Thus sitting under ongoing attack cannot be assumed sustained recovery.
pinned_public_server.attack_checks: rathena/src/map/pc.hpp:1156-1167 and unit.cpp:2902-2977,3376-3397 show normal attack dispatch/gates without an HP recovery ownership check; no claim every recorded attack was accepted.

scope: owned regression tests after parent approval
minimal_candidate_not_policy_change_appl.interrupt: On explicit react_damage=rest acquire persistent recovery/RestScript ownership before returning immediate Rest; retain prior combat script and FarmPlan as suspended rather than replace goal. step_script must not fall through to saved script until recovery completes.
minimal_candidate_not_policy_change_appl.priority: Later monster attack, heartbeat KEEP and next_action=grind must not erase recovery automatically. Define explicit precedence/cancellation for FLEE and goal changes rather than silently override Clef choices. Preserve FLEE; do not auto-convert REST to FLEE.
minimal_candidate_not_policy_change_appl.recovery_contract: Use configured/script-layer recovery threshold distinct from entry 0.25, derived only from fresh received HP/maxHP; numeric resume ratio is a parent policy decision, not inferred target mechanics. Stay suspended across same/next ticks, tiny HP rebounds, forced server standing and missing acknowledgements.
minimal_candidate_not_policy_change_appl.pose_contract: After received HP threshold is met, request standing through existing paced bounded SELF pose gate; release combat only after received matching SELF standing. Received standing alone never proves HP recovery. Guard Attack as well as MoveTo; no optimistic HP/pose mutation.
minimal_candidate_not_policy_change_appl.mechanical_contract: Prevent empty ACTIVE recovery output from triggering mechanical_actions loot/patrol fallback; emit/retain explicit recovery intent or suppress only mechanical fallback while recovery owns execution. Event drain/keepalive and strict readiness remain active.
minimal_candidate_not_policy_change_appl.under_attack: Source forces stand after sourced damage, so interruption fixes contradictory executor behavior but does not promise survival. Flee-then-rest is a separate explicit policy decision if resting under pursuit is ineffective.

regression_cases: Vertical ScheduledAgent.tick + real EventDrivenBrain + PlayingClient using recorded startup/rest answers and synthetic received fixtures: no Attack in same tick or following ticks after rest while HP below configured resume threshold.
Received SELF sitting then server-forced standing while HP still low must not resume combat; peer/nonpose/malformed/stale frames never authorize resume.
HP 19/86 ->22/86 must not bounce from sit to attack merely crossing entry threshold; exact resume threshold and maxHP changes use received values.
HP recovered but no SELF standing receipt: only paced bounded stand requests; no attack until standing receipt. Send intent is never standing.

Damage plus MonsterSpotted attack in either order, batched damage KEEP, heartbeat KEEP and generic next_action=grind cannot accidentally erase recovery. Explicit FLEE behavior preserved with documented cancellation/resume rules.
While recovering, native event drain and 20s keepalive pump continue; transport/frame/epoch/death/invalid vitals still deny execution; no fabricated readiness, HP, life or inventory.
Recovery emits no patrol/loot fallback when there are no monsters. Suspended FarmPlan/script/goal survive and resume once only after health and pose conditions.
Attack cannot bypass pose recovery after rest; pending movement never implicitly authorizes combat resumption. Preserve received-arrival semantics.
